[
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness, as well as for melanoma in situ.",
  "Surgical margins for melanoma should be based on tumor thickness.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor, and in the same operative setting whenever possible.",
  "When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1–3 mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as lesions on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and on the genitalia.",
  "The consensus rate for the recommendation is 100 % (21/21).",
  "The criteria driving the 3‑point score are streaks (irregular, 1 point), pigmentation (diffuse irregular, 1 point), and dots_and_globules (irregular, 1 point).",
  "All three criteria are minor criteria.",
  "On the image, look for irregularly distributed radial lines or pseudopods (streaks).",
  "On the image, look for asymmetric blotches of pigment (pigmentation).",
  "On the image, look for varied‑size, unevenly distributed dots or globules (dots_and_globules)."
]
